reading.title: How tech is helping in the battle against wildfires
reading.summary: Tech is being used to watch for wildfires but firefighters are still needed to put them out.

news.title: After deadly Kyiv strike, Ukraine warns interceptor shortage is costing lives
news.summary: Without Patriot interceptors, Ukraine's skies are wide open and people are fully exposed to Russia's missile barrages.
